pages.text: A hand tool that grinds roasted beans into grounds. Hold it in your $(thing)main hand$() with roasted beans in your $(thing)off hand$(), then $(thing)hold right-click$().
One bean is ground every second. The grounds keep the beans' roast and quality.

$(li)32 uses: each bean costs 1 durability.$(li)Raw beans need roasting first.$(li)Grounds go into your inventory, or drop at your feet if it's full.$(br2)A $(l:caffeinecubed:coffee_machine/grinder_attachment)Grinder Attachment$(/l) on a Coffee Machine grinds for free.
